hypothesis: Learn high-score chemistry directly using per-target nonlinear P(Y>=5) and P(Y=6|Y>=5), rather than only changing decisions on the old shared forest probabilities.
labels: Unchanged original individual 0-6 distributions; equal beers and equal tasters within beer, repeated presentations split taster weight. No fabricated labels or acetaldehyde scores.
weighting: Expand each unique beer into weighted binary outcomes. Stage1 negative/positive masses are q0+...+q4 and q5+q6; stage2 are q5 and q6. Exclude zero-weight outcomes. Balance total class masses using current training data only, then analytically undo the class-prior odds shift. This is not fitted probability calibration. Six expanded rows per leaf guarantee at least three unique beers; sparse/one-class stages use observed training conditional prior.
low_grades: Use the original ET conditional distribution over grades0-4, rescaled to 1-P(Y>=5); high5=(1-P6givenHigh)*PHigh, high6=P6givenHigh*PHigh. Low prior fallback is learned only from training beers. All new probabilities remain uncalibrated experimental individual-rating estimates, not defect safety probabilities.
selection: Apply the same 24 selective exact-tail utility policies to old and new probabilities, using the original ET grade as the baseline action in both. Fit each inner-fold class priors only on inner training beers. Apply the existing final child<=parent cap. Eligible policies: individual MAE increase<=.02 versus original ET median, individual and panel high FPR<=.02 in BOTH all50 and primary45. Choose maximum minimum individual5/6 recall on primary45, then maximum mean individual5/6 recall there, then lowest primary45 MAE, then declared policy order. No eligible policy => original ET median. This operating-point selection does not itself certify the final success criteria.
fixed_controls: Original ET median, training prior median, published previous selective workflow, fixed policy(lambda1,mu2) on old/new probabilities, and median on new probabilities. Compare new and old with the same inner selector to separate estimator benefit from decision changes. Never choose an outer-test best policy.

success.scope: Every repeat in both all50 and primary45 must pass MAE, recall and FPR gates. Primary45 precision floors apply every repeat. Beer-averaged paired bootstrap upper95 MAE increase<=.02 in both scopes. These are team experiment gates, not contest requirements; pass only means worth considering integration, not permission to integrate.

validation: Same historically inspected 250 beers, existing repeat splits, post-development repeated nested validation; not an unseen or external test. Only inner predictions determine policies; outer results do not change candidates, parameters or gates. Average repeated losses per beer before bootstrap, never treat 750 predictions as independent.
isolation: All new code/models/results live here. Existing src, official predictor/defaults, original data, delivery folder, Q2/Q3 and old results stay unchanged. No integration without separate user approval. No model binary or raw ratings in Git.
